en.brand.name: Square Hole
en.description: Part of the trading tax fills this pile, after any burn share and Flap's fee. Any curve sale fees went in at the launch. Hand in tokens to take your share of it.
en.errors.binding: This vault does not match the token. Nothing can be done here.
en.errors.insufficientFunds: Not enough tBNB for the network fee.
en.errors.read: Could not read the vault. Refresh to try again.
en.errors.reverted: The chain refused it; only network fees were spent.
en.errors.transaction: That did not go through. Check before trying again.
en.how.approval: Your wallet may ask for an approval first.
en.how.lag: New tax reaches the pile when Flap's tax processor pays out, so the pile can lag trading.
en.how.payoutNative: What you redeem is paid in tBNB to the connected wallet. A contract wallet must be able to receive tBNB.
en.how.payoutToken: What you redeem is paid to the connected wallet.
en.how.share: One token's share is the pile divided by the circulating supply. That supply leaves out only burned tokens and tokens this vault holds.
en.how.taxEnds: The tax stops when the token's tax period ends. Trades after that bring no new tax to the pile.
en.how.upgrade: Flap's Guardian can upgrade this vault's code.
en.how.whole: Whoever hands in the whole circulating supply gets the whole pile.
en.notices.burned: The tokens you hand in are burned.
en.notices.review: Flap marks this contract unverified or higher risk. Check it before you act.
en.notices.riskMissing: Flap has not given this vault's risk status. Check it before you act.
en.states.connect: Connect to see your tokens and act.
en.states.enterAmount: Enter how many tokens to hand in.
en.states.noTokens: You hold none of this token.
en.states.phase: Not available for this token yet.
en.states.tooMany: That is more than you hold.
en.states.unitUnknown: The coin this vault pays in is not known here.
en.states.wrongNetwork: Switch to BNB test network to act.
en.title: The pile
